hypothesis: A small deterministic stale-quote opportunity may exist after an authoritative resolver observation is causally known but while an outcome token remains executable; no opportunity is statewise proved unless the immutable rule explicitly defines source timestamp precision, cutoff inclusion and terminal report selection.

required: explicit inclusive or exclusive cutoff semantics
automatic_veto: missing source timestamp or receive-time provenance

causal_replay.statewise_proof: Resolver outcome known under the certified tick policy before the quote decision; executable payout-token ask plus doubled fees, slippage and failure reserve is below one dollar.

evaluation.null_outcome: Published rules may not specify terminal source-clock semantics precisely enough to support a deterministic strategy, or executable quotes may disappear before the result is causally known.
